## Notes in each chord

| Chord | Pitch classes |
| --- | --- |
| Dm7 | D · F · A · C |
| Am7 | A · C · E · G |
| C7(no3) | C · G · B♭ |
| G7sus4 | G · C · D · F |
| Dm(add11)/F | F · A · D · G |

**G7sus4:** F is a velocity-1 note; C carries over from the preceding Am7. The stronger sounding notes form **Gsus4**. **C7(no3)** has no E.

This is a bar-level harmonic reduction of humanized MIDI; brief approach notes, gaps and overlaps are not literal strumming instructions. Dm7 anticipates bars 37, 45, 69 and 77 by about 0.15 beats. Both clips start at source **5|1**, mapping source bars **5–20** to the arrangement ranges above. The differently named **High String Slurs** clips have their own part in this project.

“No chord-reference notes” is not a whole-band rest. The outro cluster has no third; its clip title is Dm(addb9,no3). The minor labels on the opening shells preserve the project's intended D-minor context, but the notes alone do not establish major or minor quality.

## Guitar voicings

Standard six-string tuning **E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4**, bass to treble. These are playable guitar reductions: original pitch classes retained, octave placement changed, no transposition. Every written tone is present.

<chord-sheet></chord-sheet>

## Source and limits

Reference clips: **2350** at 1|1, **2351** at 17|1, **2319** at 33|1, **2320** at 62|1, **2321** at 115|1. All start at clip 1|1 and are non-looping. Session clips are alternate sketches and are not added to this timeline. Producer Pal reports 91 BPM; the saved project description's 80 BPM/form is older and was not used to place sections. Audio prints were not transcribed or pitch-verified. Bass/guitar guide reads returned no note data; no chords were invented for those spans. Bar numbering assumes the reported constant 4/4 meter.

# weird doom thing - Pad accents

> **Reference source:** Saved MIDI snapshot from **6 November 2026**, not refreshed from the currently open Live set. Guitar shapes assume standard six-string tuning. Fret numbers are absolute from the nut; diagrams default to intervals in Crest Chord Reference.

**91 BPM · 4/4 · D minor · concert pitch · snapshot: 6 November 2026**

## D minor fretboard

**D · E · F · G · A · B♭ · C** — natural minor. Standard tuning **E A D G B E**; treble string at the top. D roots are highlighted.

<scale-map start="0" labels="intervals"></scale-map>

Intervals: **1 · 2 · ♭3 · 4 · 5 · ♭6 · ♭7**. Frets 0–12; the pattern repeats 12 frets higher.

Source: muted **04 LO-FI PAD** (t9, ID 2455), clip **2498**, starting at arrangement 9|1. Its 16-bar loop fills 24 arrangement bars (9-32). The audio print on t11 spans the same 24 bars but was not pitch-verified.

| Attack bars | Chord | MIDI duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9; 25 | **Dm9** | One bar |
| 13; 29 | **Dm9/A** | One bar |
| 17 | **Gm9/D** | One bar |
| 21 | **Em7b5(add11)** | One bar |

Each attack is followed by three bars without new held MIDI notes; effects can ring longer. At bars 25 and 29, the first two attacks repeat. Gm9/D = D, F, A, Bb, G. Em7b5(add11) = E, G, A, Bb, D. These are source-layer harmonies, not proof of the composite harmony under the simultaneous icy layer.

Standard tuning **E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4**. Guitar reductions retain every pitch class and the indicated bass, without transposition.
